story.text: Jane hurries back to Thornfield, and finds a blackened {RUIN}. At the {INN} the landlord tells her: Bertha set the house on {FIRE}. Mr. Rochester got the {SERVANTS} out, and climbed to the {ROOF} to save his wife; but she leapt, and the next minute lay {SMASHED} on the pavement. He was {CRUSHED} by the falling stairs. Now he is {BLIND}, has lost a hand, and lives alone at Ferndean.
story.caption: The next minute she lay smashed on the pavement
